title: Final Fantasy XVI Faithful English Localization

hero.tagline: A faithful retranslation of the original Japanese script.
hero.blurb: A complete retranslation of the game's script, made directly from the original Japanese and independent of the official English localization. It aims to present the dialogue as faithfully as possible, preserving meaning, tone, ambiguity, pacing, and characterization.
hero.notice: AI disclosure: large language models were used as a support tool for the initial drafts. The translation then went through extensive personal editing and review.

sections.name: Main cutscenes
sections.desc: Fully rendered cinematic cutscenes, the big story moments with full voice acting.

sections.name: In-engine cutscenes
sections.desc: Story scenes played in the game engine with the characters you control, one of two kinds of in-engine scenes.

sections.name: In-engine cutscenes (quest)
sections.desc: The second kind of in-engine scene, mostly used for quest and side-story moments.

sections.name: Battle events
sections.desc: Shouts, commands and short exchanges that happen during fights, often reacting to what is on screen.

sections.name: Conversations (quests)
sections.desc: Scripted conversations, many in side quests and hideaways. Several characters can speak in turn.

sections.name: Conversations (story)
sections.desc: Scripted conversations tied to the main story. Several characters can speak in turn.

sections.name: Party chatter (story)
sections.desc: Comments from your companions while you play, during story sections.

sections.name: Party chatter (quests)
sections.desc: Comments from your companions while you play, during quests.

sections.name: Townsfolk (story)
sections.desc: Optional talk with townspeople and other non-story characters during story sections.

sections.name: Townsfolk (quests)
sections.desc: Optional talk with townspeople and other non-story characters, mostly in quest areas.

sections.name: Ambient chatter
sections.desc: Incidental one-off voice lines such as reactions, remarks and greetings. Neighbouring lines in a file can be unrelated.

sections.name: Level events
sections.desc: Lines triggered by scripted moments in a level: directions to the player or party, reactions and short exchanges.

sections.name: Synopses
sections.desc: Narrated summaries of the story so far.
